epochPublic.description: Public data of one mailbox epoch (SPEC §5.2-5.3). Everything needed to recompute and verify the epoch head.

encryptionPubkey.description: Hawk encryption public key: X25519(32) || ML-KEM-768 ek(1184).

signingPubkey.description: XEdDSA mailbox signing public key (32 bytes).

previousEpochHead.description: Head of epoch N-1; absent for epoch 0.

selfSig.description: XEdDSA by this epoch's signing key over 'minos.unstructured_signature.epoch_self:' || head.

prevSig.description: XEdDSA by the previous epoch's signing key over 'minos.unstructured_signature.epoch_prev:' || head.

transportAttestation.description: [CB-18] Binds an epoch head to the account's MLS chat identity: Ed25519 by a chat device transport key over 'catbird.labyrinth.epoch_head_attest:' || did || ':' || head.

transportPubkey.description: Ed25519 public key of the attesting chat device.

sealedMessage.description: One v1.1 sender-encrypted message (SPEC §7.2). A redacted item ([CB-38]) keeps messageId, timestamp, mekId and senderTransportPubkey, carries redaction, and has an empty signedEncMessage.

signedEncMessage.description: Ed25519 sig(64) || suite-tagged AEAD ciphertext of the padded frame; empty once redacted.

redaction.description: Present when the author unsent the message ([CB-38]).

ownerMessage.description: One owner-encrypted message or delete-for-me tombstone (SPEC §7.1, [CB-37], [CB-38]).

epochNumber.description: Epoch whose root key derived the message key.

version.description: Cipher version. Writers use 5 ([CB-37]: binds messageId and timestamp; content kind byte for delete-for-me tombstones); readers also accept 0, 2, 3 and 4 (SPEC §7.1).

encrypted.description: Suite-tagged AEAD ciphertext of the padded frame.

recipientEpochHead.description: Head of the recipient epoch the MEK is encrypted to.

serverOrder.description: The order mls-ds assigned to a record when it was written ([CB-27]). Readers bound a removed chat key by it instead of the sender's timestamp.

seq.description: Per-conversation (owner batches: per-mailbox) Labyrinth write counter.

chatSeq.description: The conversation's last chat entry seq at the write, linearized against MLS commits; absent outside a conversation.

receivedAt.description: Receive time on the server clock.

redaction.description: A redaction of a sender item. Two variants. (1) [CB-38] author unsend: transportPubkey and sig, Ed25519 by one of the author's chat device keys over 'catbird.labyrinth.redaction:did=' || did || ';message_id=' || messageId || ';thread_id=' || hex(threadId). (2) Server redaction for an account deletion (deleteAccountData / purgeAuthor): transportPubkey is absent; by is the redacting (sequencer) DS's DID, reason is 'accountDeleted', redactedAt is the server's, and sig, when present, is Ed25519 by that DS's redaction key over the UTF-8 string 'catbird.labyrinth.ds_redaction:by=' || by || ';did=' || author DID || ';message_id=' || messageId || ';reason=accountDeleted;redacted_at=' || redactedAt || ';thread_id=' || hex(utf8(threadId)). Readers show variant 2 as 'account deleted' only when sig verifies under the key of the conversation's sequencer DID, and otherwise as 'removed by server'; never as an author unsend.

transportPubkey.description: The author's chat device Ed25519 key.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature: by the author's chat device key (unsend) or by the DS redaction key (server redactions; optional there).

redactedAt.description: Set by the server when it applied the redaction.

by.description: Server redactions: the DID of the DS that applied it (the conversation's sequencer).

reason.description: Server redactions: why the server redacted the item.

spaceBatchRedaction.description: Authoritative tombstone overlay for an item in an immutable sender batch. Apply after verifying the source record.

spaceBatchView.description: An immutable Space batch reference and its authenticated sequencer order. Server tombstones remain authoritative even if the source ciphertext is still readable.

space.description: Conversation Space reference, bound to the storage generation.

generation.description: Immutable UUID identifying this conversation storage lifecycle. A recreated Space requires a new generation.

itemCount.description: Original batch item count. Only a complete distinct redaction overlay can replace a purged source record.
